title: Concrete diagonal and successive totals and shuffle components
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian]. For $X:\Delta\times\Delta\to\operatorname{Ch}^{\geq0}(\mathcal C)$ define $D(X)$ as the total of its diagonal alternating coface bicomplex, and $T(X)$ by first totaling the two alternating coface directions and then the internal complex, using [def-sp-double-complex-total]. Thus $D^m=\bigoplus_{n+r=m}X^{n,n,r}$ and $T^m=\bigoplus_{a+b+r=m}X^{a,b,r}$, with differentials $\delta_{diag}+(-1)^n d_r$ and $\delta_1+(-1)^a\delta_2+(-1)^{a+b}d_r$. Use the canonical coproduct inclusions and induced maps of totals. For a subset $\mu\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ define $\alpha_\mu(i)=\#\{j\in\mu:j<i\}$, $\epsilon(\mu)=(-1)^{\#\{(i,j)\in\mu\times\mu^c:j<i\}}$, and the shuffle summand $\epsilon(\mu)X(\alpha_\mu,\alpha_{\mu^c})$ followed by the inclusion of the $(|\mu|,|\mu^c|,r)$ summand into $T^{n+r}$. All these are the original shuffle definitions, with unchanged names and bodies.
